rubricCategories.name: Argument and outcome constraints
rubricCategories.definition: Prescribed argument values, written content, targets, scope, or final-state properties
rubricCategories.example: Include the specified recipient in the calendar event's attendees

rubricCategories.name: Ordering and preconditions
rubricCategories.definition: A named action must precede another or satisfy a prerequisite
rubricCategories.example: Read the meeting transcript before updating the spreadsheet

rubricCategories.name: Response content and presentation
rubricCategories.definition: User-facing messages' content, wording, structure, or formatting
rubricCategories.example: Put the created event's title on its own line in the final response

rubricCategories.name: Tool-output grounding
rubricCategories.definition: Claims, arguments, and decisions must faithfully reflect retrieved evidence
rubricCategories.example: Ground the BBQ limit in the written reply, not an inaccessible voice note

rubricCategories.name: Specific-tool workflows
rubricCategories.definition: Use or avoid a specified tool or service in preference to an alternative
rubricCategories.example: Read the document body with Docs, not a Drive export

rubricCategories.name: Clarification and assumptions
rubricCategories.definition: Requirements on when and how to ask for missing information or resolve ambiguity, including when to proceed without asking
rubricCategories.example: Ask when the teams should bring their robots onto the stage

rubricCategories.name: Process constraints
rubricCategories.definition: Restrictions on redundant calls or prescribed procedures
rubricCategories.example: Avoid repeating a tool call once its result is already known

rubricCategories.name: Lookup and provenance
rubricCategories.definition: Obtain information from an authoritative source or preserve its provenance
rubricCategories.example: Include the source draft's title or version in the reminder

rubricCategories.name: Unsupported-action and recovery requirements
rubricCategories.definition: Handle unavailable operations or tool failures as instructed
rubricCategories.example: State that engagement metrics are unavailable when none are retrieved

goldUserTurns.definition: Initial user request plus nonempty conversational user replies in the first gold trajectory; excludes authoring hints, system setup, and empty termination messages.
